queries.name: throughput_5m
queries.sql: SELECT extract(epoch from time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp))::integer AS bucket, count(*)::float AS value FROM otel_logs_and_spans WHERE project_id = %(project_id)s AND timestamp >= %(start)s AND timestamp < %(end)s GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp) ORDER BY time_bucket('5 minutes', timestamp)

queries.name: service_throughput_1h
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(resource___service___name, 'null') AS service, extract(epoch from time_bucket('1 hours', timestamp))::integer AS bucket, count(*)::float AS value FROM otel_logs_and_spans WHERE project_id = %(project_id)s AND timestamp >= %(start)s AND timestamp < %(end)s GROUP BY COALESCE(resource___service___name, 'null'), time_bucket('1 hours', timestamp) ORDER BY service, bucket
